items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: The interviewee mentions Tito Puente only as a third party in a story about Cal Tjader ('he was here with Tito Puente once') and describes Puente playing at the Palladium, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship between himself and Puente.

ctx.x: Oh he was a wonderful musician, and a great guy. I really treasure that moment, that little bit of time where we got to — and then we remained friends and whenever he came through town, like he was here with oh a couple of different people, he was here with Tito Puente once, he was here with Gap Mangione in a little band. Different bands. And we’d always get together and hang out. I miss him. He was a great guy, a great player.
Do you consider yourself a big band drummer?
